verdict.rationale: ubuntu-docs-3 explicitly states you can "run Ubuntu alongside" Windows, directly confirming dual-boot support, and ubuntu-docs-10 references creating a bootable USB for install. However, there's no detailed documentation of the dual-boot install process itself (partition resizing, bootloader/GRUB handling alongside Windows) or independent hands-on confirmation that dual-boot works smoothly. Missing for 10: step-by-step dual-boot installation guide, evidence of GRUB/Windows bootloader coexistence handling, and community/hands-on reports confirming successful dual-boot setups.
